svg.title: Planning above the team: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#239)
svg.desc: Everything in SoftTrack belongs to a team and is seen through membership of it, so work that takes three teams is three epics with the same name, and whoever answers for the whole sees one team’s board. The epic adds initiatives, milestones and goals above the team, a roadmap, dependency view and portfolio across teams, an ideas inbox and pages, and an organisation view with scheduled summaries.
svg.text: Planning above the team: how the pieces fit
· initiatives, a shared roadmap, goals and an organisation view

g.text: What spans teams, and when it must be true.
Epics from any team, under one name.
Why, and how anybody will know it worked.
On teams you are on, or all of them for an organisation viewer.
Every epic on one time axis.
Progress, forecast and health of every epic.
Suggested and voted on, then decided.
Specs beside the epics they describe.
FOR WHOEVER ANSWERS FOR THE WHOLE
Read every team, without joining any.

g.text: the one exception, and its limits

svg.text: A team you are not on
Its epic, inside an initiative you can
Its row on the roadmap and the
Until now seeing a team’s work has taken membership, with no exception. #282 adds one, as a flag a site admin grants
to a named person, logged and revocable.

g.text: two chains, then five on their own

svg.text: Everything here except #282 stays inside the rule that seeing a team’s work takes membership. An epic from a team you are not on appears inside an initiative as a name and a
progress bar, and as nothing more. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue, #276 to #285.
